summary.headline: Week 2 post-redesign (Day 8-14): GSC weighted position at 22.68 (worsened from 17.81 last week, +5.47 vs baseline). Clicks 148 (+14 WoW), impressions 16,961 on CTR 0.87%. GA4 sessions 452 (-2.8% WoW), engagement 49.3% (vs 55.8% baseline). Two-week verdict: clicks +7.3% WoW and CTR ticking up despite lower impressions — quality of remaining traffic improving. Weighted position regressed this week, but the position metric is heavily influenced by long-tail Phoenix impressions where we already had weak rankings. Engagement dropped below baseline this week (49.3% vs 55.8%) — worth monitoring next week.
content_strategy: Pet turf cluster gap: /artificial-pet-turf/ page exists and is well-optimized (FAQPage schema, 1560 words) but 'pet turf' (4400 sv KD=0) and 'artificial turf pet' (4400 sv KD=3) still need internal-link consolidation and homepage promotion. Currently #1 ranking opportunity sitting on the table.

Phoenix-local SEO: 16/30 Phoenix-targeted keywords ranking but with avg position much weaker than US equivalents. Zero local-pack appearances detected in 30 Phoenix SERPs. GBP optimization sprint is highest-leverage local move — primary category, NAP consistency, service areas, review velocity.
Putting green expansion: 'turf putting green' (5400 sv KD=0) and 'putting green turf' (4400 sv KD=0) both have existing pages but underranked. Add comparison-table content and how-to install module.

How-to install pillar: 'how to install an artificial lawn' (5400 sv) is ranking #16 on /diy-guide-to-installing-artificial-turf-in-your-backyard/. One internal-link sprint from product pages + FAQ expansion should push it inside top 10.
Title length sweep: home title 66 chars triggers SERP truncation. Trim to <60. Single-line fix, immediate CTR benefit on 5,545 weekly impressions.
next_steps: Shorten home title from 66→60 chars to prevent SERP truncation. Highest-impression page on the site (5,545/wk).
GBP audit + optimization sprint to close the US ↔ Phoenix ranking gap. 16/30 Phoenix keywords ranking but local pack appearances = 0.

Push /diy-guide-to-installing-artificial-turf-in-your-backyard/ to top 10 for 'how to install an artificial lawn' — currently #16 with 5,400 sv. Add internal links from product pages + FAQ-style answer block.
notes: Tracked keywords (Week 2): 18 top-3, 39 top-10, 45 top-20, 33 not ranking out of 100. US: 34/70 in top 10. Phoenix: 5/30 in top 10.
Local Pack: 0 detections of theturfyard.com across 30 Phoenix SERPs scanned. GBP optimization remains the biggest local lever.
Core Web Vitals (PSI) returned 429 quota exceeded on all 10 calls for the 3rd consecutive week. Provisioning a dedicated PSI API key (free tier ~25k/day) is the only persistent data gap.
